delete.summary: Revokes a key of any user.

get.summary:
The roles, for the user form. Same list as `/roles`, for a caller who
manages users but not roles.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: RFC 3339. Rows at or after this time.

get.summary:
The signed-in user, their roles and effective permissions. Authenticated,
no permission.
The keys of the signed-in user.

post.summary:
Creates a key with some of the permissions the caller holds. The key is
in this response only. A request made with an API key cannot create one.

403.description: A permission the caller lacks, or the request used an API key

delete.summary: Revokes a key of the signed-in user. A key of another user is not found.

post.summary:
Hands the Owner role to another enabled user. The caller loses it and may
keep another role. Requires the Owner role and the caller's password; this
is the one documented exception to the one-permission rule.

403.description: The caller is not an Owner, or the password is wrong

get.summary:
The permission catalog, in catalog order. The list is public knowledge
inside the app: the users page needs it for direct grants.
Every quality profile, ordered by name.

post.summary:
Creates a quality profile. The cutoff must be an allowed quality or group
of the profile.

delete.summary: Deletes a quality profile that no movie uses.

patch.summary:
Changes a quality profile. The result must satisfy the same rules as a
new profile.

get.summary: Every role: the Owner role first, then by name.

post.summary: Creates a role with permissions the caller holds.

delete.summary:
Deletes a custom role. A role that users hold needs `confirm=true`; the
users lose it. Refused for the Owner role, and for a role that holds a
permission the caller lacks.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required when users hold the role.

403.description: The Owner role, or a permission the caller lacks

409.description: Users hold the role and `confirm` is not set

patch.summary:
Changes a custom role. Refused for the Owner role, and for a role that
holds a permission the caller lacks.

403.description: The Owner role, or a permission the caller lacks

get.summary: Whether the first-run setup is still required. Public.

post.summary:
Creates the first user with the Owner role and signs it in. Public while
no user exists, 409 after.

201.description: The Owner exists and is signed in; the response sets the session cookie

422.description: The library refused the name, email or password

post.summary:
Creates a user who can sign in with the given password. Only roles the
caller holds in full can be assigned.

403.description: A role the caller does not hold in full

delete.summary:
Deletes a user and their sessions. Refused for an Owner unless the caller
is an Owner, and for the last enabled Owner.

403.description: An Owner and the caller is not one

patch.summary:
Changes a user. Refused for an Owner unless the caller is an Owner. The
last enabled Owner cannot be disabled or lose the Owner role.

403.description: An Owner, or a role the caller does not hold in full

409.description: The email is taken, or this is the last Owner

put.summary:
Replaces the direct grants of a user. Only permissions the caller holds
can be added or taken away.

200.description: The user with the new grants

403.description: An Owner, or a permission the caller lacks

permissions.description:
The permissions chosen at creation. The key never exceeds what its
owner holds now.

prefix.description: The first characters of the key. The key itself is shown once.

actorUserId.description: Empty after the actor is deleted; `actorName` still names them.

data.description: Changed fields with old and new values. Never a secret value.

key.description: The key. This is the only response that carries it.

isOwner.description: The user holds the Owner role.

permissions.description:
Effective permissions in catalog order: every role plus direct grants.
An Owner has the whole catalog.

Permission.description: One entry of the permission catalog, `resource:action`.

code.description: Stable machine-readable string. Clients switch on this.

type.description: URI that identifies the problem kind.

oneOf.description: Qualities that count as equal. The id is 1000 or more.

ProfileItem.description: One entry of the ordered list, lowest quality first.

cutoff.description: The id of an allowed quality or group at which upgrades stop.

upgradeAllowed.description: A better release replaces an existing file until the cutoff.

isOwner.description: The built-in Owner role. Read-only; it holds the whole catalog.

users.description: Number of users who hold the role.

description.description: An empty text clears the description.

required.description: True until the first user exists.

keepRoleId.description: A role the caller keeps instead of the Owner role. None means no role.

targetUserId.description: An enabled user who receives the Owner role.

isOwner.description: The user holds the Owner role.

permissions.description: Direct grants only; the effective set also has the roles' permissions.

disabled.description: Disabling signs the user out everywhere.
